install.title: Add Kindred to your Home Screen
install.intro: On iPhone, Kindred can only send you notifications once it's on your Home Screen. It takes three taps.
install.step2Detail: Scroll down the list if you don't see it
install.step3Title: Open Kindred from the new icon

common.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Press and hold the link to copy it instead.

circleSetup.agreeTerms: I agree to the terms of use and privacy policy.
circleSetup.termsRequired: Agree to the terms of use and privacy policy to continue.

welcome.title: Set up Kindred
welcome.nameHeading: What should the family call you?
welcome.nameHint: Filled in for you if you used Google.
welcome.recipientIntro: This names the shared space everyone in the family will see.
welcome.recipientRequired: Enter what the family calls them.
welcome.relationshipHint: Everyone who joins picks their own.
welcome.notMedical: Kindred keeps logistics, not health records. Nothing here is a medical file.
welcome.inviteIntro: Everyone you invite sees the same tasks, appointments and updates for {{name}}.
welcome.shareHint: Opens WhatsApp, Messages or email on your phone. The link works for 14 days.
welcome.copyInstead: Sharing isn't available here. Copy this link and send it to your family:
welcome.membersHint: People show here once they've opened the link and joined.
welcome.makeAdmin: Also make {{name}} an admin. Admins can remove members and are told when something goes overdue.
welcome.skip: Skip for now — invite people later

join.heading: You're invited to {{name}}'s Care Circle
join.about: Kindred is where the family keeps track of who's doing what for {{name}}: tasks, appointments and updates, in one place.
join.title: Join {{name}}'s Care Circle
join.relationshipHint: Shown next to your name in the member list.
join.oneCircle: You can be in one Care Circle at a time. If you're already in another, Kindred asks you to leave it first.
join.otherCircleHeading: You're already in a Care Circle
join.otherCircleBody: You can be in one Care Circle at a time. To join {{name}}'s, first leave your current one from Care Circle settings.
